mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, with t-test p-value > 0.05 against zero mean return.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, boosting equity valuations via lower real rates and positive forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.2%, with t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and triggers positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of recession and prompts aggressive monetary policy responses, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 104.0, with t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 240.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, which triggers expectations of delayed rate cuts and higher real yields, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 240.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%, with t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong rebound in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past 6 months, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a robust economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive momentum, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals strong labor market tightening, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to anticipated rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200 and UNRATE < 5.1%, with t-test p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 for two consecutive months, coupled with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock with labor market deterioration, which increases recession risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 104.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%, with t-test p-value > 0.05.
